title: 第4章 迎接龙头
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

杜静芳一切全看在眼里，不由蹙起眉头，本想埋怨几句，但见她双目莹然，珠泪欲滴，就忍住不说了。

正在这时，忽听身后传来一阵喊声：“万丈——狂澜——”

崔莹十分奇怪，问道：“老师，那是什么？”杜静芳说：“那是运货口号。每家物流公司的口号不同，喊出来是通知绿林道上的朋友。押运货物，七分靠交情，三分靠本领，公司老板手面宽，交情广，大家都买面子，这货物押运起来就顺利。绿林道上的一听口号，知道是哪个公司的货物，本想动手去抢的，碍于面子也只好放他过去，这叫‘江湖不是打打杀杀，江湖是人情世故。’哈哈，要是你去押运货物，这样不到半天就得罪多少人？本事再大十倍，那也寸步难行。”

崔莹一听，很是不服，暗想：“我干嘛要去运货呐？”可是不敢跟老师顶嘴，笑着说：“我是错了嘛！老师，那喊的是哪家物流公司啊？”杜静芳说：“那是东都万澜物流集团，长三角一带数他最大啦，全国都有分公司。老总厉士玉，号称‘马踏长江两岸，拳打南北五路’，现在也有七十岁了吧。”

崔莹说：“老师认识他们厉总吗？”杜静芳说：“曾会过面。厉士玉凭自创的三十六路威风激穿拳、十八路荣光之爪，当年可是打遍天下无敌手，称得上威风八面！”崔莹很是高兴，说道：“他们走得太快啦，一会赶上去，您给我引荐引荐这位老豪杰吧。”杜静芳笑着说：“他自己怎么还会出来运货？真是傻孩子。”

崔莹连着给老师吐槽几次，很不是滋味，她知道自己对江湖上的事情完全不懂，嘀咕：“我不懂，就说给我听嘛。干嘛老数落人家。”拍马追上车队去和母亲说话解闷，回头一看自己的马，尾巴给那麻子弄断了，也不禁暗暗吃惊，心想一掌打断一杆枪并不稀奇，马尾巴是软的，怎能用手割断？勒马想等老师上来请教，但一转念，又赌气不问了，追上了西日阿洪说：“我的马尾巴不知怎么断了，真难看。”说着嘟起了嘴。西日阿洪知她心意，说道：“小将这坐骑不知怎么搞的，今儿老是闹倔脾气，说什么也制它不了。您骑术好，劳驾帮我治一下行吗？”崔莹一听，很是开心，说道：“就怕我也不成呢。”两人换了坐骑。西日阿洪的马其实乖乖的，半点脾气也没有。西日阿洪还赞了句：“您真厉害，连马也服您。”

李梅怕车走快了颠簸，是以这队人一直缓缓而行。但听口号声越喊越近，不一会，二十几辆车队赶了上来。

杜静芳怕有熟人，背转了身，将一顶大草帽遮住半边脸，偷看马上武师。七八名武师纵马经过，只听其中一名武师嘟囔：“听白公子说，三姊已有了下落。”杜静芳大吃一惊。回头看那武师，晃眼间只看到他满脸胡子，黑漆漆的一张长脸，等他擦身而过，见他背上负着一个红色背包，还有一对奇形武器，竟是外门中的利器五行轮，寻思：“难道辽阳六煞也入职万澜物流做了武师？”

辽阳六煞除了白文娟外，其余五人杜静芳都未见过，只知人人身怀绝技，个个武艺高强，五煞佟奔、六煞佟飞善使五行轮，外家功夫极是了得。

她心下盘算，这次出门来遇到了不少武林高手，万澜物流是在运货，那也罢了，其他那些人如果是为自己来的，实在是凶多吉少，避之犹恐不及。偏偏这个女学生少不更事，还不断去招惹人家。不过看情形又不像是为自己而来，王万户曾经是好朋友，决不致不念旧情。那么他们一批一批西去，又为的何来？

崔莹和西日阿洪换了坐骑，见他骑了没尾巴马，暗自好笑，勒定了马等老师过来，笑着说：“怎么对面没人来了？从昨天算起，已有五对人往西去啦。我倒真想再见识见识几个英雄好汉。”

这句话提醒了杜静芳，以手加额说：“啊，我真正老糊涂啦，怎么没想到‘千里接龙头’这回事。”只因心中挂着自己的事，尽往与自己有关的方面去推测，哪知全想岔了。崔莹问：“什么叫‘千里接龙头’？”杜静芳说：“那是江湖帮会里最隆重的礼节，通常是帮会中地位最高的六人，一个接一个去迎接一个人，最隆重的时候要出去十二人，一对一对出去。现在已过了五对，那么前面一定还有一对。”崔莹问：“他们是什么帮会？”杜静芳说：“这个可不知道了。”又说：“你看南北兄弟和那挥手割断你马尾巴的人都是这帮会的，声势当真非同小可。千万别再招惹，知道了吗？”崔莹嘴上答应，心中可不大服气，一心要看前面来的又是何等样人。

中午住了店，对面仍无人来，杜静芳暗暗纳罕，觉得事出意外，难道所料不对？岂知前面没人来，后面倒来了人，只听一阵驼铃响，尘土飞扬，一大队商队赶了上来。

待渐行渐近，只见数十匹骆驼夹着二三十匹马，杜静芳也不以为异。突然眼前一亮，一个粉衣女郎骑了一匹青骢马，纵骑小跑，轻驰而过。那女郎秀美中透着一股英气，光彩照人，当真是丽若春梅绽雪，神如秋蕙披霜，两颊融融，霞映澄塘，双目晶晶，月射寒江。

Page (1/3)

Du Jingfang saw everything in her eyes and couldn't help but frown. She wanted to complain a few words, but when she saw her eyes sparkling with tears, she held back.

At this moment, I suddenly heard a cry from behind: "Wanzhang - Kuanglan -"

Cui Ying was very surprised and asked: "Teacher, what is that?" Du Jingfang said: "That is a cargo slogan. Each logistics company has a different slogan. When it is shouted out, it is used to notify friends on the Green Forest Road. Escorting goods depends on friendship 70% and skill 30%. The boss of the company has a wide range of hands and friendships. Everyone buys face, so the goods will be escorted smoothly.When I heard the slogan on Green Forest Road, I knew which company's goods it was.I wanted to grab it, but I had to let him go because of face. This is called "Jianghu is not about killing, but it is about human nature."Haha, if you go to escort the goods, how many people will you offend in less than half a day?No matter how powerful you are, you can't do it."

When Cui Ying heard this, she was very dissatisfied and thought to herself: "Why should I transport goods?" But she did not dare to talk back to the teacher and said with a smile: "I was wrong! Teacher, which logistics company are you calling?" Du Jingfang said:"That's Dongdu Wanlan Logistics Group. It's the largest in the Yangtze River Delta and has branches all over the country. The boss, Li Shiyu, is known as 'horses riding on both sides of the Yangtze River and punching the north and south roads'. He must be seventy years old now."

Cui Ying said: "Teacher, do you know Mr. Li?" Du Jingfang said: "We have met before. Li Shiyu relied on his own 36-way Mighty Power Punching Fist and 18-way Glory Claw. At that time, he was an invincible fighter in the world and was called the Eighth Mighty Master.Face!" Cui Ying was very happy and said: "They are going too fast.Please introduce this old hero to me soon." Du Jingfang said with a smile: "How can he come out to transport goods by himself?"

Cui Ying complained to the teacher several times in a row, which was very unpleasant. She knew that she didn't understand the things in the world at all, so she muttered: "I don't understand, just tell me. Why are you always scolding others?" She patted her horse and caught up with the team to talk to her mother to relieve her boredom. When she looked back at her horse, her tail was broken by the pockmark, and she couldn't help but be surprised. She thought that it was not unusual to break a gun with one palm. The horse's tail is soft, how can it be cut off by hand?He reined up his horse and wanted to wait for the teacher to come up and ask for advice, but then he changed his mind and stopped asking. He caught up with Xiri Ahong and said, "My horse's tail is broken for some reason. It's really ugly." He pouted.Xiri Ahong knew what she was thinking and said, "I don't know what happened to my young general's horse. It is always in a bad temper today. I can't control it. You are good at riding. Can you please help me treat it?" Cui Ying was very happy when she heard this and said, "I'm afraid I won't be able to do it either." The two of them changed their mounts.Xiri Ahong's horse is actually well-behaved and has no temper at all.Xiri Ahong also praised: "You are so powerful, even horses obey you."

Li Mei was afraid that the car would bump if it went too fast, so the group kept walking slowly.But the slogans were getting closer and closer, and after a while, a convoy of more than 20 cars caught up.

Du Jingfang was afraid of seeing an acquaintance, so she turned her back, covered half of her face with a big straw hat, and peeked at the martial artist on the horse.Seven or eight martial arts masters passed by on horseback, and one of them muttered: "I heard Mr. Bai say that the third sister has been found." Du Jingfang was shocked.Looking back at the martial artist, all I could see in a blink of an eye was his beard and long, dark face. When he passed by, I saw a red backpack on his back and a pair of strange-shaped weapons, which turned out to be the five-element wheel in the outer door. I wondered: "Could it be that the Liusha of Liaoyang also joined Wanlan Logistics as a martial artist?"

Except for Bai Wenjuan, Du Jingfang has never seen the other five Six Evils of Liaoyang. He only knows that they all possess unique skills and are highly skilled in martial arts. The Fifth Evil, Tong Ben, and the Sixth Evil, Tong Fei, are good at using the Five Elements Wheel. Their martial arts are extremely good.

She calculated in her mind that she met many martial arts masters when she went out this time. Wanlan Logistics was transporting goods, so that was fine. If those other people came for her, they would be in danger and she would have to avoid them.However, this female student was always troubled and kept provoking others.However, it doesn't look like he is here for himself. Wang Wanhu was once a good friend, and he will definitely miss his old relationship.Then they went west in batches, and why did they come?

Cui Ying and Xiri Ahong changed their mounts and saw that he was riding a tailless horse. They were secretly amused. They reined up their horses and waited for the teacher to come over. They said with a smile: "Why is no one coming from the other side? Since yesterday, five pairs of people have gone west. I really want to meet some more heroes."

This sentence reminded Du Jingfang, and she put her hands on her forehead and said, "Ah, I am really stupid. Why didn't I think of the 'connecting the faucet from a thousand miles away'?" Because he was worried about his own affairs, he tried his best to speculate on aspects related to himself, but he thought that everything was wrong.Cui Ying asked: "What is 'thousands of miles to meet the leader'?" Du Jingfang said: "That is the most solemn etiquette in the Jianghu gang. Usually the six highest-ranking people in the gang go to greet one person one by one. At the most solemn time, twelve people go out, one by one. Now that five pairs have passed, there must be another pair ahead." Cui Ying asked"What kind of gang are they?" Du Jingfang said, "I don't know this anymore." Then she added, "Look, the brothers from the north and south and the person who cut off your horse's tail with a wave are all from this gang. The momentum is really extraordinary. Don't provoke them again, understand?" Cui Ying agreed, but she was not convinced in her heart. She wanted to see what kind of person was coming in front of her.

Checked into the hotel at noon, but no one came across the street. Du Jingfang secretly wondered, thinking something unexpected happened, could it be that she expected something wrong?Unexpectedly, no one came from the front, but people came from behind. There was only a sound of camel bells, dust was flying, and a large group of caravans caught up.

As they got closer, they saw dozens of camels carrying twenty or thirty horses, and Du Jingfang didn't think it was strange.Suddenly his eyes lit up, and a girl in pink riding a green horse trotted by at a light gallop.There is a sense of heroism and radiance in that girl's beauty. She is really as beautiful as spring plum blossoms blooming in the snow, and her spirit is like autumn husk covered with frost. Her cheeks are melting, the clouds reflect the clear pond, her eyes are sparkling, and the moon shines on the cold river.
